# Metadata schema_tables_by_schema

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  table_schema,
  COUNT(*) AS table_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN table_type = 'BASE TABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_tables,
  SUM(CASE WHEN table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS views
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE
  NOT table_schema IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog')
GROUP BY
  table_schema
ORDER BY
  table_count DESC
```
